usageNotes: Use this to inventory all Ceph pools on the cluster and audit their replication, PG, and autoscaler settings. The target node must be online and have Ceph services running; any node that is a full Ceph MON member will return the same cluster-wide pool list. Requires either Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit at the root path — both are checked with 'any', so either privilege is sufficient.

examples.summary: List all Ceph pools from node pve1

tips: bytes_used and percent_used are optional — they may be absent for a pool that has never received data or whose stats are still initializing after creation.
autoscale_status shape changes across Ceph releases (Pacific, Quincy, Reef); parse it defensively.
pg_num_final is the pg_autoscaler's recommendation; if it differs significantly from pg_num the cluster may be under- or over-provisioned for PGs.
The 'type' field distinguishes replicated from erasure-coded pools — erasure pools cannot host RBD images used by VM disks without a special CRUSH profile.
